description.en: Unique identifier of the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace: [Get workspaceId](~~2782167~~)

title.zh: 视频理解-获取异步任务状态和结果
title.en: Video Understanding – Retrieve asynchronous job status and result

descriptions.zh:
阿里云百炼轻应用-视频理解-获取异步任务状态和结果：通过这个接口可以查看“提交异步任务”接口提交的视频理解任务状态和结果。欢迎前往[视频理解控制台](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend)体验。
> 当返回结果中包含`header -> errorCode = ViolationOfSecurityPolicy`时，表明该请求触发了系统的安全策略限制，请对请求内容进行相应的修改。此时，`videoAnalysisResult`等业务数据返回为空。
>
descriptions.en:
Alibaba Cloud Model Studio light application – video understanding – get the status and result of an asynchronous task. Use this API to check the status and result of a video understanding task submitted via the “Submit asynchronous task” API. Try it in the [Video Understanding console](https://bailian.console.aliyun.com/#/app/app-market/quanmiao/video-comprehend).

> If the response includes `header -> errorCode = ViolationOfSecurityPolicy`, the request triggered a system security policy restriction. Modify the request content accordingly. In this case, business data such as `videoAnalysisResult` returns empty.
